C-RELEASE-CANARY-PRERELEASE.IntentSummary: Prerelease lane in .github/workflows/release.yml: a hyphenated owner tag (vX.Y.Z-beta.N / -canary.N, base equal to the current train computedVersion) is admitted by authorize-tag without the Ready seal, materials or preflight gates (tagger identity, annotated tag, seal=HEAD and train-document checks stay), builds and signs on the unchanged release-signing lanes, renders a prerelease-only body (automated verification block, no reviewed materials, no brew line, direct-asset install wording), publishes as a GitHub prerelease that is never latest (assert isPrerelease=true and that releases/latest did NOT advance), and skips publish-cask. Every stable-path step keeps byte-identical behavior for non-hyphenated tags. Train README boundary note and release-process prerelease subsection document that a prerelease tag is not a train dispatch and carries no acceptance.

Corner.Situation: Owner tag v2.9.0-beta.1 pushed by the release bot while the train is Collecting
Corner.Expected: authorize-tag admits it (tagger, annotated tag, seal=HEAD, train document present, base version v2.9.0 equals computedVersion); readiness/materials/preflight steps and the release-identity artifact are skipped; both build lanes sign and notarize as usual; publish exposes the draft with isPrerelease=true and asserts releases/latest still names the previous stable tag

Corner.Situation: Non-hyphenated stable tag (train Ready, seal in place)
Corner.Expected: every step behaves exactly as before: Ready-state and exact-tag equality enforced, strict admission repeated in build, materials and preflight gates run, publication clears the prerelease flag, latest-advance verification and cask handoff execute

Corner.Situation: Hyphenated tag whose base does not match the train computedVersion (e.g. v2.9.1-beta.1 while the train computes 2.9.0)
Corner.Expected: authorize-tag rejects the tag before any secret or candidate code executes

Corner.Situation: Hyphenated tag with an unexpected suffix shape (v2.9.0-nightly or v2.9.0-beta.x)
Corner.Expected: authorize-tag rejects it; only -beta.N and -canary.N are admitted prerelease shapes
the job is skipped through its own needs/if condition; a stable tag still runs it unchanged

Corner.Situation: Publication rerun after a partial prerelease publish (draft already exposed)
Corner.Expected: the reconcile step keeps treating the existing non-draft release as already_published; asset and body verification remain idempotent; no clobbering

Corner.Situation: WINDOWS_RELEASE variable on and off during a prerelease
Corner.Expected: on: the NSIS exe and sidecars join the verified asset set; off: windows assets stay build-only workflow artifacts — identical semantics to the stable lane

automated verification block (attestation, cosign, assets sentence) plus a prerelease notice with direct-asset install and rollback wording; no brew line, no reviewed-notes extraction, no What's New materials

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Identity step derives PRERELEASE from the tag suffix (only -beta.N / -canary.N admitted); prerelease path keeps PUSH_ACTOR, annotated-tag, seal=HEAD and train-document checks, requires base == computedVersion and a well-formed train state, skips Ready equality; job outputs prerelease; the payload-checks, strict admission, materials, preflight and release-identity artifact steps gain if: non-prerelease conditions.

The admitted-check-evidence download, repeated strict admission, materials gate and metadata preflight steps run only for non-prerelease tags; typecheck:ipc and every packaging/signing/smoke step stays unconditional.

prepare-publication render step branches: prerelease body = automated verification block + prerelease notice (direct-asset install and rollback wording), no notes extractor call, no brew line; stable body path byte-identical.

Prerelease: gh release edit --draft=false --prerelease=true; assert isDraft=false, isPrerelease=true, tagName match; assert releases/latest still names the previous stable tag (loop until inequality is stable). Stable: existing --prerelease=false + latest-advance assertions unchanged.
publish-cask adds authorize-tag to needs and an if-condition excluding prerelease tags; stable behavior unchanged.

docs/release-trains/README.md boundary note and docs/release-process.md subsection: a prerelease tag is not a train dispatch, needs no Ready seal, records no acceptance, never advances the updater feed or cask; owner tag semantics (tag app + release environment) unchanged.

release.yml FILE header: VERSION bump, MODULE_MAP entries for the new branches, CHANGE_SUMMARY line; .grace/graph/features.xml M-046 summary updated; .grace/verification/features.xml V-M-046 prerelease scenario/evidence entry added.

npm run release:governance green; npx vitest run tests/renderer/release-governance.test.js tests/renderer/release-train.test.js green; grace target assertions during implementation and final assertions with --run-commands before archive.
